timeline.event: Present Campanone cast by Luigi Valadier

tiers.everyday: The Campanone is the great bell of St Peter's Basilica in Rome. The present bell was cast in 1785 and weighs nearly 9 tonnes.
tiers.student: Vatican pages give the Campanone as cast in 1785 by Luigi Valadier, 8,950 kg, 2316 mm across, nominal MI2 +5/16. An earlier campanone was recast in 1352–54 after the fire of 1303; electric ringing dates from 4 November 1931.
